name: DW-E2-seed-without-int32-wrap
old: export const tileDecorationSeed = (x, y) => Math.imul(x, 73856093) ^ Math.imul(y, 19349663);
why: JS's `^` takes each operand through ToInt32, which wraps an exactly-represented product modulo 2^32 just as Math.imul does; a map pixel's coordinates (under 1000) keep x * 73856093 far under 2^53, so the two forms agree on every pixel the world has.
